Priya Shah: Quick hire ops question: candidate asked if company match contributions are taxed when vested or only when distributed. Need a short sentence for offer FAQ.

Liam Torres: Employer match is not taxable to the employee when contributed; tax events happen on distribution. Employer contributions are pre-tax for the plan and follow normal plan tax rules.

Avery (Finance): Add: any in-plan Roth conversions of employer or pre-tax funds are a taxable event at conversion time. If candidate asks, say: 'Employer contributions are not taxable when contributed; converting pre-tax to Roth is taxable.'

Priya Shah: Good. Another nuance: they asked whether they can roll over an HSA from a prior employer into our HSA and still use our payroll pre-tax deduction same pay period. Any timing rules?

Benji Carter: You can open an HSA with our custodian anytime. Rollover (trustee-to-trustee) timing is independent of payroll elections. Payroll deductions can start once enrollment is processed. If they need funds immediately for a bill, suggest: 1) open HSA here and use personal funds, 2) process rollover (takes ~7-14 days), 3) request reimbursement per custodian rules.

BenefitsBot: HSA FYI: custodial payback/reimbursement rules vary; check internal HSA FAQ: https://redwood.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/PeopleOps/pages/HSA-FAQ (internal).

Priya Shah: One last: candidate asked about FSA/HSA overlap if they elect a limited-purpose FSA and our HDHP same month. Will payroll allow HSA deductions?

Liam Torres: Limited-purpose FSA that is dental/vision only does not block HSA. The system checks election types + effective dates. If both effective month aligns and FSA is full-purpose, payroll will block HSA. If limited-purpose, payroll proceeds. If theres a timing edge-case, benefits can open a vendor ticket to BrightPlan with tag "redwood-payroll-impact" and payroll can apply a manual override after documentation.

Avery (Finance): I'll ask payroll to add a short note for recruiting: 'If planning to contribute to an HSA, choose limited-purpose FSA or confirm HDHP effective date doesn't overlap non-HDHP coverage.'

Priya Shah: Thanks all  I'll update the hiring FAQ and offer packet with these lines. :+1:
